A '''snow monster''' [[Species/Legends|species]] lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Its body, several times larger than that of an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]], was covered in [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-green fur, and the monster bore several large claws and [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], after the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] surface was turned to snow and [[Water/Legends|ice]] by a powerful being known as the [[Snow King]], one creature encountered the Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]].

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], the snow monster stood several times taller than an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species native to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. Except for its head, face, and two [[Limb/Legends|hands]] and feet, the monster was mostly covered in [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-green fur. While the monster's crown was covered in a darker green fur, its face, hands, and feet were left bare and exposed the monster's pale, tan skin. Each of its four limbs ended in three clawed digits, and its mouth contained several large [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].<ref name="SS" />

==History==
[[File:ScaredEwoks-TSS.png|thumb|left|200px|The Ewoks and Iceheads encounter the monster on Endor.]]
The snow monster made its home on the Forest Moon of Endor.<ref name="SS" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="EwoksDate">{{EwoksDate|appearance of the [[Water/Legends|snow]] [[Species/Legends|monster]]|[[The Season Scepter]]}}</ref> after the moon's surface had been turned to snow and [[Water/Legends|ice]] by a powerful being called the [[Snow King]], the Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] journeyed to a [[Sun King's palace|palace]]&mdash;the home of the Snow [[King/Legends|King's]] brother, the [[Sun King]]&mdash;in a [[flying leaf]] sent by the Snow King's sister, the [[Leaf Queen]]. Along the way, however, they were attacked by several [[Icehead]]s, servants of the Snow King's mistress, [[Odra]]. When the Ewoks and Iceheads, aboard the flying [[Tree/Legends|leaf]], entered a cave near the [[Star/Legends|Sun]] Palace, they encountered a snow monster, which wailed at the Iceheads before it lunged at them. The Iceheads and the monster fell to the surface below and were momentarily buried in snow; when the Iceheads emerged, they discovered that the monster was behind them, and they retreated with the monster chasing after them.<ref name="SS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The snow monster goes unnamed during its appearance in "[[The Season Scepter]],"<ref name="SS" /> the thirteenth episode of the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] television series. "The Season Scepter," written by [[Bob Carrau]] and directed by [[Raymond Jafelice]], first aired on [[November 1]], [[1986]].<ref name="A Star Wars CELibration">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
